description: PLUSGOLF Shinperio (New Perio) handicap: handicap = (gross on 12 hidden holes - par on those holes) x 1.5; net = gross - handicap. Provide hidden_holes (12 hole numbers) or omit them to use the deterministic house draw. Returns the ranking by net score.

course_name.description: Used to seed the house draw when hidden_holes is omitted.

name: plusgolf__plusgolf_shinperio
